response.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) AS average_total FROM Invoice WHERE Total IS NOT NULL AND Total > 3.98;

assumptions.assumption: "Higher-value" means strictly greater than 3.98, so an invoice with Total exactly 3.98 is excluded. Missing totals are filtered out explicitly, though Invoice.Total is NOT NULL so none exist. AVG returns NULL when no rows qualify, and no rounding is applied.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat 3.98 as an inclusive cutoff, so invoices with Total exactly 3.98 are also kept (greater than or equal to 3.98).
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(Total) AS average_total FROM Invoice WHERE Total IS NOT NULL AND Total >= 3.98;
